name: Expert_Alligator
summary: This EA implements Bill Williams' Alligator indicator strategy for trend-following trading. It uses the standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework with CSignalAlligator to generate buy/sell signals based on the alignment and crossover of the Jaw, Teeth, and Lips smoothed moving averages. Position sizing is handled by a fixed lot money management module with no trailing stop applied.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标策略进行趋势跟踪交易。它使用标准MQL5专家顾问框架，通过CSignalAlligator根据颚、齿、唇三条平滑移动平均线的排列和交叉来生成买卖信号。仓位管理采用固定手数资金管理模块，未使用追踪止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标策略，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件依赖三条平滑移动平均线（颚线13周期偏移8、齿线8周期偏移5、唇线5周期偏移3）的排列状态：当唇线在齿线上方且齿线在颚线上方时产生做多信号，反之产生做空信号，CrossMeasure参数(5)用于确认交叉的有效性。出场条件由Expert框架的默认逻辑处理，信号反转时平仓并开反向仓，但未设置明确的止损止盈。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedLot固定手数模式，固定交易0.1手，Percent参数(10.0)用于风险百分比计算。资金管理方面，固定手数模式不根据账户余额动态调整，缺乏自适应风险控制机制。未使用追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，意味着盈利头寸无法通过移动止损锁定利润。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements Bill Williams' Alligator indicator strategy, a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions rely on the alignment of three smoothed moving averages (Jaw: period 13 shift 8, Teeth: period 8 shift 5, Lips: period 5 shift 3): a buy signal is generated when Lips are above Teeth and Teeth are above Jaw, and vice versa for sell signals, with the CrossMeasure parameter (5) confirming the validity of crossovers. Exit conditions are handled by the Expert framework's default logic, closing positions and opening reversals when signals invert, but no explicit stop-loss or take-profit levels are set. Position sizing uses the CMoneyFixedLot fixed lot model, trading a constant 0.1 lots, with the Percent parameter (10.0) used for risk percentage calculations. Money management lacks adaptive risk control since the fixed lot model does not dynamically adjust position size based on account balance or volatility. The absence of a trailing stop (CTrailingNone) means profitable positions have no mechanism to lock in gains through a moving stop-loss.

pros: 使用经典的比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标策略，理论基础扎实，被广泛验证
采用MQL5标准Expert框架模块化设计，代码结构清晰，信号、追踪、资金管理分离
CrossMeasure参数提供了信号确认机制，可以过滤虚假交叉信号，减少频繁交易
EveryTick设为false减少无效tick处理，降低交易频率和滑点风险
参数验证(ValidationSettings)确保输入参数的合法性，增强鲁棒性
pros_en: Uses the well-established Bill Williams Alligator indicator strategy with solid theoretical foundation and wide validation
Modular design using MQL5 standard Expert framework with clear separation of signal, trailing, and money management components
CrossMeasure parameter provides signal confirmation mechanism to filter false crossovers and reduce excessive trading
EveryTick set to false reduces unnecessary tick processing, lowering trade frequency and slippage risk
Parameter validation (ValidationSettings) ensures input legitimacy, enhancing robustness
cons: 未使用追踪止损，盈利头寸无法在趋势反转时锁定利润，可能导致盈利回吐
固定手数资金管理不考虑账户规模和波动率变化，缺乏自适应风险控制
没有明确的止损和止盈设置，依赖信号反转平仓，在剧烈行情中可能造成大额亏损
鳄鱼指标是滞后指标，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，无法在趋势发展过程中优化仓位
cons_en: No trailing stop used, profitable positions cannot lock in gains during trend reversals, potentially giving back profits
Fixed lot money management ignores account size and volatility changes, lacking adaptive risk control
No explicit stop-loss or take-profit settings, relying on signal reversal for exits which can cause large losses in volatile markets
Alligator is a lagging indicator, prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks position scaling logic, unable to optimize position size as trends develop
improvements: 添加追踪止损模块（如CTrailingFixedPips或ATR追踪止损）以在趋势中保护利润
实现动态仓位管理，根据ATR波动率或账户余额自适应调整手数
增加明确的止损止盈设置，并结合市场波动率（如ATR倍数）动态计算止损距离
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop module (e.g., CTrailingFixedPips or ATR-based trailing) to protect profits during trends
Implement dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on ATR volatility or account balance
Add explicit stop-loss and take-profit with volatility-based calculation (e.g., ATR multiples) for dynamic stop distances

risk_points: 没有明确的止损设置，在极端行情中可能面临大额亏损风险
固定手数不考虑账户变化，小账户可能过度交易，大账户可能资金利用率不足
鳄鱼指标滞后特性在震荡市中产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: No explicit stop-loss, exposing the account to large losses in extreme market conditions
Fixed lot sizing ignores account changes, potentially overtrading small accounts or underutilizing large accounts
Lagging nature of Alligator generates false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
